Subject: SOC 2 Type II report access + audit period clarification

Hi Sergio,

Hope you're well. We're progressing through our vendor security review for ClearStream Analytics and need to obtain Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or a bridge letter) plus any guidance on the audit period covered. Specifically: 

- Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report for the 2025 audit period? If not, can you provide a bridge letter that confirms controls remained materially the same for the requested timeframe?
- What secure transfer methods do you support for report/evidence delivery (SFTP, secure Drive, vendor portal)?
- Can you provide a short checklist of the artifacts you typically share so we can route requests internally?

We're aiming to finish the security review by the end of May. A small set of one-line reply templates for our procurement team would be helpful if you have standard language.

Thanks — let me know who I should expect these from and an approximate delivery ETA.

Best,
Lena Park
Sr. Security Analyst
ClearStream Analytics

What I'll attach/offer by EOD Monday:
- Copy of our latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary) or a signed bridge letter that can cover the gap(s).
- A short artifact checklist (authentication logs, access control policy snapshots, change management sample, retention settings) — attached as an "SOC2 evidence checklist".
- Secure transfer instructions and options (SFTP details or Drive link) — attached.
- One-line reply templates you can paste into procurement emails (two variants: report attached vs. bridge letter).

Quick ask: what audit period does ClearStream need covered (calendar year 2025, fiscal Q3 2025, etc.)? If you can confirm the exact dates, we can make sure the bridge letter language matches.

I'll loop in Marissa (Trust & Compliance) on the attachments and any follow-ups for additional evidence.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199
